title: Binding Requirements for the Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy
content:
A Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy is bound only for a household that meets every requirement below at the time of binding.

1. **Residence policy.** The primary residence of the named insured is insured on a live Larkspur HomeGuard, CondoGuard or RentGuard policy when the umbrella is bound. A live policy is one that is bound, in force, pending cancellation or pending nonrenewal.
2. **Underlying insurance.** Every exposure the umbrella extends over is scheduled as underlying with at least the tier's required limit for its line (the minimum underlying limits of the umbrella's tier for homeowners, condominium, renters, landlord dwelling, auto and watercraft policies).
3. **Exposure capacity.** Rated exposures stay within the tier's most vehicles, most youthful drivers, most rental dwelling units, most watercraft and longest watercraft, and no rental property may have more than the tier's most dwelling units at one rental property.
4. **Liability claims.** The household's count of liability claims paid in the lookback is below the tier's liability claims figure at binding. The count is the liability claims paid for the household by any carrier in the lookback years ending on the bind date, as disclosed on the application and on Larkspur claim records (liability claim entries on HomeGuard Homeowners Policy, CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy, RentGuard Renters Policy and LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy claim files, and umbrella claim payments), each claim counted once.
5. **Attachment.** A bound umbrella moves to in force on its effective date.

## Evidence for the residence requirement

The residence requirement is read from the company's own records of the customer's HomeGuard Homeowners Policy, CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy and RentGuard Renters Policy: the status of each such policy and, for a HomeGuard policy, the occupancy on file. It is judged as those records stand before the umbrella is bound. A LandlordGuard Dwelling Fire Policy, a FloodGuard Private Flood Policy or a Larkspur Valuables Floater does not satisfy it, because none of them is a HomeGuard, CondoGuard or RentGuard policy.

| Status of the HomeGuard, CondoGuard or RentGuard policy on the primary residence | Live for this requirement? |
|---|---|
| Bound | Yes |
| In force | Yes |
| Pending cancellation | Yes |
| Pending nonrenewal | Yes |
| Cancelled or expired | No |

## Requirements at a glance

| Requirement | Met when |
|---|---|
| Residence | A live HomeGuard, CondoGuard or RentGuard policy insures the named insured's primary residence at binding |
| Underlying | Each exposure is scheduled at or above its line's minimum for the tier |
| Capacity | Every rated count is at or within the tier figure, and every rental property has no more units than the per-property figure |
| Claims | The claims count on the bind date is below the tier figure |

All four are required together; the umbrella is bound only when every one is met.

## Hypothetical cases

- A household whose only Larkspur residence coverage is a RentGuard policy pending cancellation meets the residence requirement, since pending cancellation is live.
- A household with a claims count of 1 on the bind date, against a figure of 2, meets the claims requirement; a household with a count of 2 does not, since 2 is not below 2.
- An umbrella bound today with an effective date next month stays bound until that effective date, when it moves to in force.
